# Vendored SCAP 1.4 / OVAL 5.12.3 schemas

This directory is a pinned copy of the schema set used by the SCAP-NG iteration 001
migration tooling.

Source repository: `vanderpol/scap-content`  
Source revision: `32ab7642b4d9e9eb02476d59698dd3f83ae0e282`  
Source path: `schemas/scap-1.4-oval-5.12.3/`

The files are retained with their original contents and embedded license/disclaimer
text. They are reference dependencies for validating source SCAP 1.4 content and
generated standalone OVAL research artifacts. They are not SCAP-NG schemas.

The vendoring workflow copies the complete source schema directory without
modification and writes `VENDOR-MANIFEST.json` containing SHA-256 digests.
